def replaceVertex {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) (s t : V) [DecidableEq V] : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj := λ v w =>
    if v = t then
      if w = t then
        false
      else
        G.Adj s w ∧ w ≠ s
    else if w = t then
      G.Adj s v ∧ v ≠ s
    else
      G.Adj v w
  symmetry := by
    intros u v h
    cases (eq_dec u t) with
    | true H1 =>
      cases (eq_dec v t) with
      | true H2 =>
        simp [H1, H2] at h
        contradiction
      | false H2 =>
        simp [H1, H2] at h
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
        exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    | false H1 =>
      cases (eq_dec v t) with
      | true H2 =>
        simp [H1, H2]
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
        exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
      | false H2 =>
        simp [H1, H2] at h
        exact G.symmetry h
  irrefl := by
    intro v
    cases (eq_dec v t) with
    | true H =>
      intro h
      simp [H] at h
      exact False.elim h
    | false H =>
      exact G.irrefl v
